dex.text: A pair of large, hairy hands with nobody attached, that scuttle out of the hedge after dark and grab at whatever is passing. Mostly steering wheels. Sometimes handlebars. Once, memorably, a picnic.
dex.fact: From about 1910, drivers and cyclists on the B3212 near Postbridge on Dartmoor reported hairy hands seizing the wheel and forcing them off the road.
